title: Cases Review — All 7 Cases
grammarPoint: Complete review of all 7 Polish cases: functions, key prepositions, and most common patterns encountered in A1–A2
grammarPoint_fa: مرور جامع هفت حالت دستوری لهستانی و کاربرد هر کدام

explanation.text:
Polish has 7 grammatical cases. Here is a complete A2-level review.

## The 7 Cases at a Glance

| Case | Polish Name | Core Function | Key Prepositions |
|------|------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Nominative** | Mianownik | Subject | — |
| **Genitive** | Dopełniacz | Possession, negation, after numbers | do, z, bez, dla, od, po, koło |
| **Dative** | Celownik | Indirect object, beneficiary | dla (purpose), — |
| **Accusative** | Biernik | Direct object, direction | na, w (direction), przez, za |
| **Instrumental** | Narzędnik | With, by means of, profession | z, przed, za, między, nad |
| **Locative** | Miejscownik | Location (always with preposition) | w, na, przy, o |
| **Vocative** | Wołacz | Direct address | — |

## Key Patterns (Summary)

### GENITIVE — most frequent case
- Possession: książka **mamy** (mum's book)
- After negation: nie ma **czasu** (no time)
- After numbers 5+: pięć **dni** (five days)
- After do/z/bez/dla/od/po/koło
- Genitive plural = extremely common: dużo **studentów**

### DATIVE — the 'to/for' case
- Indirect object: Daję **mamie** prezent. (I give mum a present)
- Podoba **mi się** (I like it) — dative of interest
- Zimno **mi** jest. (I'm cold) — dative of feeling

### ACCUSATIVE — direct object + direction
- Direct object: Czytam **książkę**. (I'm reading a book)
- With na/w for direction: idę **na** rynek (to the market square)
- Duration: przez **tydzień** (for a week)

### INSTRUMENTAL — 'with', tools, professions
- With: kawa **z mlekiem** (coffee with milk)
- Profession after być: Jestem **studentem**. (I am a student)
- Manner: **pociągiem** (by train)

### LOCATIVE — location only (always with preposition)
- w **Warszawie** (in Warsaw)
- na **stole** (on the table)
- o **ósmej** (at eight o'clock)

## Noun Endings Quick Reference (masculine example: student)

| Case | Singular | Plural |
|------|---------|-------|
| Nom | student | studenci |
| Gen | student**a** | student**ów** |
| Dat | student**owi** | student**om** |
| Acc | student**a** (animate) | student**ów** |
| Instr | student**em** | student**ami** |
| Loc | student**cie** | student**ach** |
| Voc | student**cie** | studenci |
notes: Genitive is the most frequently needed case — after most prepositions and after negation.
Locative NEVER appears without a preposition. If you see 'w/na/przy/o + noun' → locative.
Dative is used for 'Podoba mi się' (I like it), 'Daję ci' (I give you), all indirect objects.
Instrumental after 'być' for profession: 'Jestem nauczycielem' (not nominative after być!).

explanation_fa: هفت حالت: فاعلی (mianownik) — فاعل. مضاف‌الیهی (dopełniacz) — مالکیت، نبود، بعد از nie. دادی (celownik) — مفعول غیرمستقیم. مفعولی (biernik) — مفعول مستقیم. ابزاری (narzędnik) — ابزار، همراهی، هویت. مکانی (miejscownik) — مکان با حرف اضافه. ندایی (wołacz) — خطاب مستقیم.

exercises.prompt: Nie ma ___ w domu. (There is no time at home.) [genitive after negation]
exercises.explanation: After negation 'nie ma' → genitive: czas (m) → genitive: czasu. 'Nie ma czasu' = There is no time. Contrast: 'Jest czas' (nominative). Negation always triggers genitive of the object.

exercises.prompt: Daję ___ prezent. (I'm giving mum a present.) [dative — indirect object]
exercises.explanation: Indirect object (to whom?) → dative: mama → mamie (f dat: -a → -ie). 'Daję mamie prezent' = I give mum a present. 'Mamy' = genitive (mum's). 'Mamą' = instrumental (with mum).

You heard: 'Jestem studentem na Uniwersytecie Jagiellońskim.' — I am a student at the Jagiellonian University. After 'być' (profession/identity) → instrumental: student → studentem. 'Na Uniwersytecie' = locative (at/on the university).

exercises.prompt: Jadę ___ Kraków jutro. (I'm going to Kraków tomorrow.) [direction — accusative]
exercises.explanation: 'Do + genitive' = to (destination, cities/places). 'Jadę do Krakowa' (Kraków → gen: Krakowa). Note: 'do' takes genitive not accusative, but it expresses direction. 'Na' + acc = direction to open spaces/events.

exercises.prompt: Build: I travel to work by train. (instrumental — manner of transport)
exercises.explanation: 'Jadę do pracy pociągiem.' — I travel to work by train. 'Do pracy' = to work (do + genitive: praca → pracy). 'Pociągiem' = by train (instrumental: pociąg → pociągiem). Means of transport always uses instrumental in Polish.
